GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG004 (11 Dec 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1395)
APO 500
11 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Branch Firms in Japan.
1. Reference is made to the following memoranda for the Imperial Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
a. File AG 130 (22 Sep 45) ESS, SCAPIN 45, 22 September 1945, subject “Control of Financial Transactions;
b. File AG 386 (14 Nov 45) ESS/FI, SCAPIN 280, 14 November 1945, subject “Transactions in Property in Japan Owned or Controlled by Persons Outside of Japan:”
c. File AG 004 (14 Jan 46) ESS/FI, SCAPIN 592, 14 January 1946, subject “Operation of Branches and Agencies in Japan, Owned or Controlled by Persons Outside of Japan: ”
d. File AG 095 (3 Sep 46) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 2118-A, 3 September 1946, subject “Operation of Branches or Agencies in Japan Owned or Controlled by Persons Outside of Japan.”
2. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to prohibit any branch firm whose head office is outside Japan to make an investment in another company without prior approval from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
